notes: Special purpose vehicles that hold AI data centers or GPUs and carry the debt that paid for them, keeping it off the tenant's balance sheet. Amounts are USD billions as reported; null = undisclosed. status: closed (financing completed), raising (in market), reported (press reports, terms unconfirmed). 'stress' records the latest reported secondary price of the SPV's loans or bonds, in cents on the dollar (100 = par). Reviewed weekly with data/ai-deals.json.

spvs.name: Beignet Investor LLC
spvs.terms: Meta leases all facilities on an initial four-year term with extension options; Meta's residual value guarantee covers the first 16 years if a lease isn't renewed or is terminated

events.text: PIMCO-issued investment-grade bonds ($27B) backed by project assets; Blue Owl ~$7B equity for 80% of the JV

spvs.name: Sopaipilla Investor LLC (Meta El Paso)
spvs.terms: Hyperion-style structure: senior secured notes issued by a vehicle 80% owned by BlackRock's GIP and HPS; Meta keeps 20% and is developer, operator and sole tenant. Priced at higher yields than Hyperion's 2025 deal. JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley arranged the bond sale

events.text: Over $13B package led by Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan, reported as Meta's CDS hit a record
$12.3B of senior secured notes launched; S&P preliminary A+, Fitch expected AA-
Priced at $12.5B, at higher yields than a comparable deal last year (WSJ)

spvs.name: Project Jupiter
spvs.project: Doña Ana County, New Mexico (2.45 GW)
spvs.terms: STACK Infrastructure-developed campus leased by Oracle to host OpenAI capacity; Oracle served a force majeure notice in Sept 2026

stress.note: Loan quoted at 89–91 cents after Oracle's force majeure notice

events.text: $18B of loans and bonds led by SMBC, MUFG, BNP Paribas and Goldman Sachs
Oracle invokes force majeure to shield itself from payments if delays push the facility beyond 2028; Oracle says the project remains on schedule

spvs.name: Vantage Data Centers (Texas & Wisconsin)
spvs.project: Two Stargate campuses developed by Vantage for Oracle
spvs.terms: Two term loans ($23B and $15B), four-year maturities with two one-year extensions

events.text: Bloomberg: JPMorgan, MUFG and other lenders still distributing the $38B after more than six months; some are selling pieces to non-bank buyers at a discount

spvs.name: Stargate Michigan (Saline Township)
spvs.terms: $16.3B package: ~$14B of bonds secured on the campus (7.5% coupon, 19.5 years, 6 years interest-only then 13 amortizing) plus ~$2B equity; structured by Bank of America after US banks stepped back

events.text: Financing closed; PIMCO anchored about $10B of the bond tranche

spvs.name: xAI Colossus 2 GPU vehicle
spvs.terms: SPV buys Nvidia GPUs and leases them to xAI for five years; GPUs are the collateral; Nvidia up to $2B of the equity

spvs.name: CoreWeave DDTL 4.0
spvs.terms: SOFR+225 (5.9% fixed tranche); secured by GPUs and customer contracts

events.text: Parent CoreWeave's 5-year CDS hits a record 1,194.5 bp (60%+ implied five-year default odds, up from 368 bp on Oct 6); its 2031 notes trade at 79 cents. The DDTL is secured by GPUs and customer contracts, not the parent

spvs.name: CoreWeave DDTL 5.0
spvs.terms: First publicly syndicated HPC infrastructure-backed financing; funds capacity for two large non-investment-grade customers

spvs.name: CoreWeave DDTL 5.5
spvs.terms: Delayed-draw term loan maturing Sept 1, 2031; SOFR + 5.50% after price talk widened from 4.25–4.50% and the issue price fell from 99 to 97 cents. Customer contracts behind it average about three years, shorter than the loan

events.text: Closed at SOFR + 5.50%, a full point wider than DDTL 5.0, after price talk widened; contracts behind it (~3 years) are shorter than the ~5-year loan

pricing.note: SOFR + 5.50% at 97 cents; marketed at 4.25–4.50% and 99 cents, widened to clear

spvs.name: Lambda term loan B vehicle
spvs.project: GPU deployment for an investment-grade customer
spvs.terms: Asset-backed SPV funding GPUs for an investment-grade customer; amortises with contracted cash flows and hardware life

spvs.name: Volta Infrastructure GPU loan
spvs.project: Tydal, Norway (121 MW, leased from Bitdeer)
spvs.terms: $1.3B first-lien term loan C plus a $3.7B term loan backed by GPUs, six years; SOFR + 6.25–6.50% at 97–98 cents (about 11–11.75% yield); no corporate guarantee. Funds GPUs and a letter of credit for the data-center lease. Anthropic has a reported six-year, ~$10B compute contract at the site

events.text: JPMorgan begins sounding out lenders for about $5B
Marketed at about 11% yield and 97–98 cents; JPMorgan and Goldman reportedly limited their own exposure; commitments due Oct 14

spvs.name: SharonAI GPU-backed facility
spvs.project: Australia (first of several financings toward 68,000+ Nvidia GPUs by mid-2027)
spvs.terms: Senior secured facility backed by GPUs and their cash flows; SharonAI (NASDAQ: SHAZ) has a June 2026 agreement with Nvidia for a 72 MW AI factory of up to 40,000 GB300 GPUs with revenue sharing and credit support. Rate not confirmed in a source we could open

events.text: US$356M GPU-backed facility signed; Goldman Sachs among lenders (reported)
